items.summary: CFO recommendation: preserve financial containment and authorize no new spend, billing changes, launches, or monetization claims this cycle. Revenue is not supported at site level: Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21 and reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, all in an aggregate row; site-attributed income is $0. Do not assign the $4.92 to any property or claim ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift. The 39 improvements awaiting measurement, 429 delivered requests, SEO impressions/clicks, and proposal counts are activity or traffic metrics, not financial outcomes. AI spend is $2.2785467 on 2026-10-01 across 16 calls, but coverage is only 4 of 38 expected sites; treat fleet AI spend as incomplete. Monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue target, and revenue floor are blank, so budget exposure cannot be bounded. Maintain the existing capacity gate and permit only the already-queued affiliate CTA work after the CTO repair-or-close case releases a slot and overlap clears.

Retain the 2026-09-21 Amazon result as aggregate and unattributed: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, $4.92 commission, $0 site-attributed income, and $4.92 aggregate-unattributed income. Require registered tracking IDs for future affiliate links and report provider aggregate rows separately from site revenue. Do not publish revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal-lift claims until site/content identifiers, orders, shipped items, commission, and reporting-period reconciliation are available.

Keep the current financial gate unchanged. Contribution margin and cost-to-learn are not calculable because direct infrastructure/domain costs, labor or execution cost, complete AI usage, experiment exposure/outcome data, and attributable revenue are not available on a common period. Minimum measurement for a finance-ready report: period-matched site-level revenue and commission, direct change cost, infrastructure/domain allocation, complete AI cost by site/work item, and experiment/control outcomes. Do not create duplicate telemetry or spend.
